skill_analysis.next_skill_rationale: To move beyond 'tutorial hell,' you need to master the backend logic that powers AI agents, specifically moving from basic Python to building robust APIs that handle LLM streams.
Mastering this unlocks immediate ability to connect LLMs to real user interfaces.

roadmap_data.title: Python for AI Backend
roadmap_data.description: Master FastAPI and Pydantic to build high-performance endpoints for AI models.

roadmap_data.title: LLM Fundamentals
roadmap_data.description: Explore OpenAI/Anthropic APIs and experiment with system prompting and token management.

roadmap_data.title: Orchestration Frameworks
roadmap_data.description: Learn LangChain or LlamaIndex to chain together multiple AI steps and manage memory.

roadmap_data.title: Vector Databases
roadmap_data.description: Implement a vector store like Pinecone or Supabase pgvector for document retrieval.

roadmap_data.title: Full-Stack AI Deployment
roadmap_data.description: Deploy a RAG-based application using Vercel AI SDK and AWS/Supabase.

roadmap_data.title: Foundations of LLM APIs & Vector Databases
roadmap_data.description: Study core API endpoints, rate limiting, and structured JSON parsing with modern SDKs.

roadmap_data.title: Environment & Token Setup
roadmap_data.description: Configure secure server-side environment variables and token management.

roadmap_data.title: Practical Mini-Service Implementation
roadmap_data.description: Build a standalone script that handles user prompts, validates schemas, and returns structured data.

roadmap_data.title: Capstone Project Architecture
roadmap_data.description: Scaffold the full-stack interface and connect dynamic state to your AI backend service.

roadmap_data.title: Portfolio Showcase & LinkedIn Launch
roadmap_data.description: Document your project architecture, capture demo walk-throughs, and publish your case study on LinkedIn.

projects.title: Personal Knowledge Brain
projects.objective: Build a search tool for your own notes using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
steps: Create a script to chunk and embed local markdown files.
Upload embeddings to a Pinecone index.
Build a React frontend to query the index and return AI-summarized answers.
projects.expected_outcome: A functional tool that answers questions based on personal documents.
projects.portfolio_description: A full-stack RAG application that uses semantic search to query private datasets.
projects.linkedin_content_idea: Video demo: How I turned 2 years of messy notes into a searchable AI brain using LangChain.
projects.career_relevance: Demonstrates core AI Solutions Engineering skills: embedding, retrieval, and UI integration.

projects.title: AI-Driven DevTool Dashboard
projects.objective: Create a developer dashboard that automates code reviews or documentation generation.
steps: Integrate with GitHub API to fetch recent pull requests.
Use an LLM to analyze code changes and suggest improvements.
Build a real-time streaming UI in React to show the AI's thought process.
projects.expected_outcome: A production-ready dashboard for engineering teams.
projects.portfolio_description: An AI agent that performs automated code audits and generates documentation on the fly.
projects.linkedin_content_idea: Article: Why the next generation of DevTools will be built with streaming AI interfaces.
projects.career_relevance: Shows ability to build tools for other developers, a key trait for high-impact engineering roles.

projects.title: AI Content & Workflow Copilot
projects.objective: Build an end-to-end intelligent assistant that synthesizes domain prompts into structured actions.
steps: Design prompt template with schema enforcement
Connect modern responsive frontend with live state
Deploy and record a 60-second video demo
projects.expected_outcome: A working full-stack SaaS application ready for public demonstration.
projects.portfolio_description: Architected and deployed an AI copilot featuring real-time schema generation and responsive UI.
projects.linkedin_content_idea: How I built an AI workflow copilot in 14 days and what I learned about structured prompting.
projects.career_relevance: Demonstrates modern full-stack AI engineering beyond simple wrappers.

projects.title: Semantic Document Intelligence Engine
projects.objective: Ingest unstructured documentation and allow users to query it with grounded contextual citations.
steps: Chunk and vectorize documentation into embeddings
Perform cosine similarity matching on queries
projects.expected_outcome: A production-grade semantic search tool demonstrating real retrieval-augmented generation.
projects.portfolio_description: Designed a contextual document query engine with source attribution and low latency.
projects.linkedin_content_idea: Why naive prompting fails for enterprise docs and how retrieval systems solve hallucinations.
projects.career_relevance: Essential knowledge for modern AI engineering and product roles.
